visibleTargets.notes: One seated child on the left clearly raises one hand above head level.

action.en: giving the paper to the teacher

visibleTargets.notes: One child clearly hands one finished picture to the same teacher, who is receiving it.
One child near the centre-right clearly places one book into one open backpack.
One child on the right sits properly at a desk with hands calm and a closed pencil case.

principle.en: Connect each visible routine to language Basti can use at school. Accept short descriptions first, then model the useful full sentence or classroom phrase.
